name: Boulder Scout Group
description: Boulder Scout Group is an in-person community Scouting group at Boulder Scout Hall in Boulder, Western Australia. Its public website helps families looking for youth activities in Boulder and Kalgoorlie-Boulder explore four age sections, arrange a first visit, check confirmed group events and contact the group.

introductoryVisit.instructions: Contact the group before attending to confirm the correct section, date and location.
